name: repo-coding-agent
description: A repository-capable coding agent that reads and edits files, runs commands in a sandbox, discovers tools and servers, and asks a human for approval. No long-term memory, no delegation to peers, no physical actuation.

simulators.code.execute: In-memory mock interpreter and mock filesystem; no host shell.

notes: Applicable scope covers the GH, TM, CE, SC, and HT domains (96 patterns).
